Customer retention and history for tradespeople

EffiMétiers

Stay the first tradesperson your customers think of.

Who is it for?

Landscaping, renovation and heating tradespeople.

The problem to solve

Between visits, a customer may forget their tradesperson and look elsewhere. Information, costs, comments and photos need to stay accessible to prepare the next follow-up.

What the project offers

  • 01Complete customer record and visit history
  • 02Costs, comments and before-and-after photos in one place
  • 03Early reminder to prepare the next visit
  • 04The tool sends a reminder; the tradesperson contacts the customer personally
  • 05Before-and-after gallery to show work to prospective customers
  • 06EffiVerdure, EffiRénovations and EffiChauffage: three trade-specific versions

Example in practice

On 1 July, Jack mows Mrs Machin’s lawn. He records before-and-after photos, the cost and his comments. Another mow would ideally be needed about five weeks later. On 22 July, after three weeks, the tool reminds him to get back in touch: Jack contacts Mrs Machin himself before she needs to look for someone else. His gallery also helps him show his work to prospective customers.

The story behind it

After a visit, the tradesperson knows what may be needed next. EffiMétiers keeps the history and reminds them to get back in touch early enough to stay on the customer’s mind.

Available to test

Where does it stand?

Updated: 1 November 2026

EffiVerdure, EffiRénovations and EffiChauffage are ready to test. EffiRénovation has already been tested by a tradesperson; detailed feedback has not yet been received.
